name: Musike
subtitle: YouTube Music player — unsigned iOS builds
description: Musike is a free, open-source YouTube Music player by Ernani1234. Standalone on iPhone: no server needed. Builds are the unsigned IPAs published on the upstream release page; SideStore, AltStore, Feather and FlareStore re-sign them with your own Apple ID.

apps.name: Musike
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music player, audio only
apps.localizedDescription: Search YouTube Music, build playlists and play audio with the screen off — notification, lock screen and headphone controls. No ads, no account, no server needed on the phone.
apps.versionDescription:
Modded Musike for iOS — Mo's fork of [Ernani1234/musike](https://github.com/Ernani1234/musike), on the upstream v1.5.1 base.
Built from `macblizzard/musike` @ b66c1f3 on GitHub's macOS runner. **Unsigned** — FlareStore/SideStore/AltStore/Sideloadly sign it with your own Apple ID on install.

**1.5.3 — no more silent tail on downloaded tracks.** YouTube's audio streams carry silence past the end of the song. While streaming, the app already stopped at the real length reported by YouTube; a downloaded file had nothing to tell it where the song ends, so a 4-minute track showed 9 minutes with silence after the fourth. The download now records the track's length beside the audio and cuts the padding with a stream copy (no re-encode), and playback stops at the real end either way.

Also in this build:
- offline "Downloaded" collection that plays with no connection (native downloader — googlevideo has no CORS headers, so the web view can never fetch the bytes itself)
- lrclib lyrics, fetched on the device
- audio format ladder (140 -> 139 -> 251 -> 250 -> 249): YouTube refuses individual itags per session, so a refused URL falls through to the next format instead of failing the track
- iOS background hand-off alongside upstream's media session

Native mode: the backend runs inside the app, so no server or Tailscale is needed.

Modded Musike for iOS — Mo's fork of [Ernani1234/musike](https://github.com/Ernani1234/musike), upstream v1.5.1 base.
Built from `macblizzard/musike` @ 09b943a on GitHub's macOS runner. **Unsigned** — FlareStore/SideStore/AltStore/Sideloadly sign it with your own Apple ID on install.

**1.5.2 fixes offline downloads.** googlevideo answers without CORS headers, so the web view could never fetch a track's bytes; the download now runs in the native side (URLSession -> Documents, `Range: bytes=0-` so it isn't throttled) and the player reads the file straight off disk.

Also in this build:
- offline "Downloaded" collection that plays with no connection
- lrclib lyrics, fetched on the device
- audio format ladder (140 -> 139 -> 251 -> 250 -> 249): YouTube refuses individual itags per session, so a refused URL falls through to the next format instead of failing the track
- iOS background hand-off alongside upstream's media session

Native mode: the backend runs inside the app, so no server or Tailscale is needed.

Modded Musike for iOS — Mo's fork of [Ernani1234/musike](https://github.com/Ernani1234/musike) at upstream v1.5.1.

Built from `macblizzard/musike` @ ee64f4b on GitHub's macOS runner. **Unsigned** — FlareStore/SideStore/AltStore/Sideloadly sign it with your own Apple ID on install.

Added on top of upstream 1.5.1:
- offline "Downloaded" collection (audio in Cache Storage, plays with no connection)
- lrclib lyrics, fetched on the device
- audio format ladder (140 -> 139 -> 251 -> 250 -> 249): YouTube refuses individual itags per session, so a refused URL falls through to the next format instead of failing the track
- iOS background hand-off kept alongside upstream's media session

The backend runs inside the app (native mode): no server or Tailscale needed.
